answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 15856 Country: India Title: Is it sunnah to read surh DUKHAN on Friday night? Question: Is it sunnah to read surh DUKHAN on Friday night? Answer ID: 15856 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1452/1460=M=1430) Yes, it is sunnah as it is mentioned in hadith: قال رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم: من قرأ حم الدخان في لیلۃ الجمعۃ غفر لہ (الترمذي 2:117 ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
